changeinfo.changes:
-Updated connectivity version.
Once updated, you will no longer be able to
play online with players on prior versions
(1.06 or earlier).

-Improved stability.

■Additional Content
-Level Cap Increase
Raised the level cap from 1050 to 1200.

-Added "Warp to Ryne" and "Exit Dungeon" commands
to the Options section in the main menu.
The consumable items "Teleport Crystal" and
"Escape Crystal" perform identical functions.

-New Extra Quests
Added "Hunt: Destroyer of Worlds" and
"Battle: Heroes of the Fairy Realm".
※Both of these quests can only be accessed
after completing Main Episode 16.

-New Sudden Quests
Added new Boss Sudden Quests to
"Niebelheim, the Rocky Wasteland" and
"Otherworld: Rotten Forest Stage."

-Added the Infinite Transition Dungeon
※Accessible from Ryne's teleportation gate
after completing Main Episode 16.

-Added Multiplayer-Only Assault Missions
※Available after beating Floor 10 of
the infinite transition dungeon.

■Various Adjustments
-In-use equipment (marked with an "E") now shows
which character is currently using it.
※You can see what equipment is in use on the
Item screen and Equip screen, and at the Smithy.

-In-use equipment can now be equipped by other
characters without needing to remove it first.

-The cursor can now be moved while displaying
equipment details on the Equip screen.

-Equipped items now remain in their slots even if
their stock runs out.

-One-handed swords equipped as Dual Wielding sub-weapons
now display their ATK as part of a character's status.

-Weapon skill experience is now gained when
using Sword Skills.

-Important messages are now displayed in color.

-Improved maps.
・Adjusted the color of Wellgunde's first layer
when viewing the map for the second layer
to better tell them apart.
・Adjusted the main menu's map colors to better
distinguish "N."
・Portals, maintenance booths, and dungeon
entrance icons now have their own colors.
・Icons for dungeon bosses now appear on
dungeon maps.

-The mini map now always shows Otherworld Gate
map icons even when they're beyond map range.

-Players now receive a notification when an
Otherworld Gate is opened.

-Improved visibility for Sudden Quest target icons.

-Target icons are now displayed when accepting
a Challenge Quest.

-Adjusted the information display for
"Hunt" Challenge Quests.

-The Dicey Café's TV now shows a "New" icon when new
episodes of "Say It, Miss Strea!" are available.

-Upon returning to Ryne, an alert now informs
players if new items are available at the shops.

-A material shop can now be found next to the Smithy
after completing Main Episode 16.

-Adjusted in-dungeon pathfinding for allies.

-Implemented random parameters for Engraved Stones.

-Improved hit rates for some Duel Avatar Incarnate
techniques and special moves, with extra attention
paid to midair ranged attack angles.

-Adjusted ATK for all weapon types and Duel Avatars.

■Miscellaneous
-Updated save data version.
Any data saved under this version (2.01) will
no longer be readable by the 1.00 version.

-Updated connectivity version.
Once updated, you will no longer be able to
play online with players on prior versions
(1.04 or earlier).

-Improved stability.
